title: GPS Info – Western States 100
claims: The GPS Info page links a GPX file for the 2027 course, including aid station waypoints, at https://www.wser.org/wp-content/uploads/gpx/WSER2027.gpx.
The GPS Info page does not link a GPX file for the 2026 course.
The page lists crew-accessible coordinates for Duncan Canyon, Robinson Flat, Dusty Corners, Michigan Bluff, Foresthill, Rucky Chucky parking at Driver's Flat, Green Gate and Pointed Rocks.
A HEAD request on 2026-11-20 returned HTTP 200, text/xml, 538,087 bytes; the GPX names the track 2027 WSER, credits GPS Visualizer as creator, and contains 22 waypoints and 6,000 trackpoints.

A local planar measurement of the 6,000 trackpoints gives 161.23 km against 100.2 mi = 161.256 km, a 0.03 km difference; at a 1 m elevation threshold the same points give +5,537 / −7,012 m, against the official 18,090 / 22,970 ft = 5,513.8 / 7,001.3 m, and a maximum of 2,651 m.
At a 3 m threshold the same file gives only +3,609 / −4,324 m, showing that the threshold choice, not the official text, explains most of the apparent climbing gap.

The file's own desc lists five changes from 2026: Shirley lift top by road, a new five-mile trail in Granite Chief, a Duncan Canyon exit change, Little Bald instead of N43, and an adjustment before Cal-1; the file is a 2027 course, not the 2026 raced geometry, and carries no copyright line or redistribution licence.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接读取 GPS Info 页面并核对链接与坐标列表；2026-11-20 HEAD 与下载一次 WSER2027.gpx，验证文件头、22 个航点、6,000 个轨迹点，做逐点平面距离与 1 m / 3 m 阈值升降测量后删除临时文件。
